attributes.name: Druva - Backup Job Failure Spike
attributes.description: Detects a high volume of backup failures in a short period, which may indicate widespread service disruption, ransomware impact, API throttling, or infrastructure failure.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects a high volume of backup failures in a short period, which may indicate widespread service disruption, ransomware impact, API throttling, or infrastructure failure.

attributes.query:
(druva.feature:"Alerts And Notifications" or druva.feature:"Admin Event")
and (
  event.outcome:"failure"
  or druva.backup.status:"failure"
)
